notes: Scope: all of packages/sim is delivered on this branch. 53 files changed against the contract SHA and every one of them is under packages/sim/ or docs/reports/, so packages/core-types, docs/orchestration, root config, CI and all dependency declarations are untouched; no dependency was added or bumped. | Tests: pnpm -r test is green with 133 cases in 17 files (core-types 29, sim 104 in 13 files: ecs 6, move 9, raycast 7, locomotion 14, schedule 7, replay 6, light 11, fluid 11, astar 7, mob spawn 7, mob ai 7, combat 7, projectile 5). Acceptance coverage: 1000-tick random-input non-penetration, resting stability, step 0.5/1.0 climbable and 1.5 not, water drag, the 3-block free fall-damage table, DDA invariants with reach 5.0 boundaries, zero-component rays and FACE/normal agreement, light propagation on place/break/corner/chunk-seam, A* optimality against Dijkstra in a fixed maze plus the budget cutoff returning 'partial', fluid convergence without oscillation, and replay determinism. | L2 outcome: sim-c finished on its own (SIM_C_DONE) and was merged with --no-ff as a1bdb86. sim-b never finished: the first session died leaving 735 uncommitted lines in its worktree, which I rescued as d37070e before spawning a replacement; the replacement also failed after only merging the shared foundation (4a0bdfd), leaving fluidEngine.ts truncated mid-function at line 197 (tsc TS1005) and both subtree barrels still exporting nothing. I merged what existed as 1610ef1 and then implemented the rest of light and fluid myself in 09bff01, so the subtree is complete rather than partially delivered. | Light (rescued design, verified and tested by me): sky and block BFS with attenuation level - 1 - opacity - (sky ? skyFilter : 0), sky falling straight down at full strength through skyPassThrough, removals processed before additions, seedChunk/stitchBoundaries(passes)/onBlockChanged/step/drainDirtySections per the contract interface, light stored as (sky << 4) | block in one byte and never persisted. Tests prove a differential place or break ends byte-identical to a full recompute, a sealed room matches an independent in-test BFS around a two-corner doorway, and per-chunk seeding plus a 2-pass stitch equals one unconfined propagation. | Fluid (implemented by me on top of the rescued computeFluidAt): computeFluidAt stays a pure function of the neighbourhood (asserted by comparing a deep-equal copy and an unchanged world hash), scheduling uses a 33-bucket delay ring with delays clamped to 1..FLUID_TICKS.maxDelay and per-bucket dedupe, water delay 5 and lava delay 10, tick(now, budgetCells) is budget-bounded with order-preserving carry-over so a tiny budget reaches the same fixed point as an unbounded one, and settle()/scheduleAll() are test and bootstrap helpers. Lava touched by water becomes OBSIDIAN when it is a non-falling source and COBBLESTONE when it is flowing. | New deviations: (7) a falling fluid voxel that lands on the floor keeps falling = true at level 0, so it behaves as a source for its horizontal neighbours, which is what produces the expected level-1 spread at the bottom of a waterfall; (8) solidification is decided before the level recomputation for that cell, so an obsidian conversion emits fluid.changed with FLUID_EMPTY and then block.changed; (9) clearing a flowing cell also resets the block id to AIR when it is WATER_FLOWING or LAVA_FLOWING, because SimVoxelWorld.getFluid derives a source byte from the block id when the fluid byte is zero; (10) the light and fluid suites use four-chunk worlds with the seams at x = 0 and z = 0 and explicit 30s per-case timeouts, because seedChunk walks all 65536 voxels of a chunk and a 16-chunk fixture exceeded the 5s vitest default. | Carried-over deviations from the interim report, all still true: unit-voxel step quantisation (auto-step succeeds iff stepHeight >= ledge height, 1.0 is climbable only by jumping, 1.5 never); move-then-gravity integration order giving a 1.32-block discrete jump apex; PHYSICS.maxSubSteps is not a hard cap because terminal velocity needs more than 8 sub-steps to stay under 0.45 blocks; simSin/simCos replace Math.sin/Math.cos since rng.ts forbids them; AIR_CONTROL = 0.2 is local tuning with no contract equivalent; moveEntity treats velocity as per-step displacement because the contract signature carries no dt; ECS create() is immediate while add/remove/destroy are buffered until flush(), with deterministic id reuse and ascending query() order. | Integration notes for L0: import everything through packages/sim/src/index.ts, which re-exports all 11 subtrees flat with subtree-prefixed symbols. Register systems via mobSimSystemEntries() plus lightSystemEntry and fluidSystemEntry, and call mobBindContext(world, { voxels, seed, bus }) before the first tick. Systems never call world.flush() themselves; the scheduler owns flushing. | Tooling defect worth escalating: connections.notion.sendMessageToSession failed 7 out of 7 times with 'The tool call failed unexpectedly' across payloads from 150 bytes to 4 KB, while getSessionStatus and waitSession on the same session URLs kept working. Mid-flight steering of a running L2 was therefore impossible, which is the main reason a dead sim-b could not be recovered by instruction and had to be finished by hand. | head_sha is the commit the four gates were run against; this report is committed on top of it and changes nothing under packages/.
